environmentVariables.name: MAGENTO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Magento REST base URL, e.g. https://shop.example.com/rest/V1.

environmentVariables.name: MAGENTO_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: When true, update_product_attribute is not registered. Unset means writes are allowed; the mcprack companion sets true.

environmentVariables.name: MAGENTO_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: When true, TLS certificate verification is disabled (development only).
